name: Remove Generator
description: Enable to remove the Generator META tag. No configuration required!
project_description: Remove Generator is a single-hook hardening module that strips the core-added <meta name="Generator" content="Drupal ..."> tag from every page's <head>, so the site stops advertising in HTML that it runs Drupal. It implements hook_page_attachments_alter() to unset the html_head entry keyed system_meta_generator. There is nothing to configure: enable to remove the tag site-wide, disable/uninstall to let core add it back. It affects only the HTML meta tag, not the X-Generator HTTP response header (added separately by core's ResponseGeneratorSubscriber).
